name: PURE_FOOTBALL
rule: No market-derived feature, line, price, consensus or market-implied target

name: MARKET_AUGMENTED
rule: Only market observations known at forecast cutoff; immutable provider/time/version

name: MARKET_BENCHMARK
rule: Market observations used as evaluation benchmark at their legitimate timestamp; closing line may be retrospective benchmark only

name: BAS_SCIENTIFIC_ANCHOR
rule: W15 BAS-independent national pregame expected-margin anchor; cannot consume BAS target
